tags.name: Album
tags.description: Operations related to the sticker album management

tags.name: Shop
tags.description: Operations related to purchases and sales

tags.name: Characters
tags.description: Operations related to Harry Potter characters

tags.name: Exchange
tags.description: Operations related to sticker exchanges between users

bearerAuth.name: Authorization
bearerAuth.description: Paste: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN (include the word Bearer and a space)

post.description: Register a new user. username, email and password are required; housePreference is optional. credits starts at 0 and album starts empty.

200.description: User registered successfully; user is the stored document without the password field

400.description: username, email or password missing ("All fields are required"), or the email is already registered ("Email already registered")

500.description: Server error; the error field carries the underlying error message

post.description: Login and receive a JWT token

200.description: Login successful; user is the stored user document without the password field

400.description: email or password missing (error: "Email and password are required"), or unknown email or wrong password (message: "Invalid credentials")

500.description: Server error; the error field carries the underlying error message

put.description: Update authenticated user account details. Every field is optional; only the fields present in the body are changed. Sending an empty body results in a server error.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Fields to update; each one is optional

200.description: Account updated successfully; user is the updated user document without the password field

400.description: The chosen email is already used by another account

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

500.description: Server error; the error field carries the underlying error message

200.description: Account deleted successfully

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

500.description: Server error; the error field carries the underlying error message

get.description: Get authenticated user account details including credits and collection statistics

200.description: Account details retrieved successfully

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

500.description: Server error; the error field carries the underlying error message

get.description: Get the full album: one entry per card in the collection, sorted by index. Owned cards carry the stored image and a quantity greater than 0; cards not yet owned have image null and quantity 0.

200.description: Album retrieved successfully

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

500.description: Server error; the error field carries the underlying error message

get.description: Get the cards the user owns in more than one copy (quantity greater than 1). availableForTrade is quantity minus 1.

200.description: Duplicate cards retrieved successfully

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

500.description: Server error; the error field carries the underlying error message

post.description: Add virtual credits to the authenticated user. The returned credits value is the new balance, not the amount added.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Number of credits to add; must be a positive number

200.description: Credits added successfully; credits is the new balance

400.description: credits is missing, zero or negative

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

500.description: Server error; the error field carries the underlying error message

post.description: Buy a standard pack: 5 random cards drawn from the collection, costs 1 credit. Takes no request body. Cards are added to the album (quantity incremented if already owned).

200.description: Pack purchased successfully; cards always has 5 entries and may contain repeats

400.description: The user has fewer than 1 credit

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

500.description: Server error. Returns { error: "No characters available" } when the card collection is empty, otherwise { error: <underlying error message> }

get.description: Get every card in the collection, sorted by index ascending. Each item carries _id, hpId, index, name, house and image.

200.description: Characters retrieved successfully

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

500.description: Server error

get.description: Get basic info for a single card, looked up by hpId. Returns hpId, index, name, house and image.

200.description: Character retrieved successfully

400.description: The id path segment is empty

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

500.description: Server error

get.description: Get full details for a single card, looked up by hpId. Returns name, house, species, ancestry, patronus and wand.

200.description: Character details retrieved successfully

400.description: The id path segment is empty

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

500.description: Server error

post.description: Propose a 1-for-1 card trade. Only offeredHpId and requestedHpId are read from the body; card names, images and houses are resolved server-side from the collection. The proposer must hold at least 2 copies of the offered card and must not already own the requested card.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: hpId of the offered card and hpId of the requested card

200.description: Trade proposed successfully; exchange is the stored document

400.description: offeredHpId or requestedHpId missing ("offeredHpId and requestedHpId are required"); the two ids are equal ("The offered and requested cards must be different"); the proposer holds 1 or 0 copies of the offered card ("You do not have enough copies of <name>"); or the proposer already owns the requested card ("You already own <name>")

message.example: You do not have enough copies of Harry Potter

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

404.description: One or both hpId values are not in the collection ("One or both cards do not exist"), or the proposer user document is missing ("User not found")

message.example: One or both cards do not exist

500.description: Server error; always returns this fixed body

post.description: Accept a pending trade proposal. The exchange is locked by moving it from pending to processing with an atomic findOneAndUpdate so two users cannot accept it at once; on any validation failure below the status is reset to pending, and on success it becomes completed with acceptor and acceptorName set. The acceptor must hold at least 2 copies of the requested card.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: ID of the exchange to accept

200.description: Trade completed successfully

400.description: The proposer no longer holds a duplicate of the offered card ("The proposer no longer has a duplicate of <name>"), or the acceptor does not hold a duplicate of the requested card ("You do not have a duplicate of <name>")

message.example: The proposer no longer has a duplicate of Harry Potter

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

404.description: The proposer or acceptor user document is missing

409.description: The exchange does not exist or is no longer pending (already being processed or accepted by another user)

message.example: Exchange not found or already accepted by another user

500.description: Server error; always returns this fixed body

get.description: Get pending exchanges proposed by other users (the caller\'s own proposals are excluded), optionally filtered by house and/or card name

parameters.name: house
parameters.description: Optional. Keeps exchanges whose offeredHouse or requestedHouse equals this value exactly (e.g. Gryffindor)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional. Case-insensitive partial (regex) match on offeredCardName or requestedCardName

200.description: Available exchanges retrieved successfully; each item is a full exchange document

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

500.description: Server error; the error field carries the underlying error message

get.description: Get the pending exchanges proposed by the authenticated user. Only proposals with status pending are returned.

200.description: User exchanges retrieved successfully; each item is a full exchange document

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

500.description: Server error; the error field carries the underlying error message

get.description: Get the completed exchanges the authenticated user took part in, as either proposer or acceptor

200.description: Completed exchanges retrieved successfully; each item is a full exchange document with acceptor and acceptorName set

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

500.description: Server error; always returns this fixed body

delete.description: Delete a pending exchange proposal. Only the proposer can cancel, and only while the exchange is still pending; the document is removed from the collection.

200.description: Exchange cancelled successfully

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

403.description: The caller is not the proposer of this exchange

message.example: Only the proposer can cancel the exchange

404.description: No pending exchange with this id (it does not exist or is already completed)

message.example: Exchange not found or already completed

500.description: Server error; the error field carries the underlying error message

post.description: Sell one copy of an owned card for 1 credit. The card quantity drops by 1 and credits rise by 1. The last copy cannot be sold. remainingCredits in the response is the new balance.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: hpId of the card to sell

200.description: Card sold successfully; remainingCredits is the new balance

400.description: The user owns only one copy of this card

message.example: You cannot sell the last copy of a card

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

404.description: The user does not exist or does not own a card with this hpId

500.description: Server error; the error field carries the underlying error message

post.description: Buy a maxi pack: 9 random cards drawn from the collection, costs 3 credits. Takes no request body. Cards are added to the album (quantity incremented if already owned).

200.description: Maxi pack purchased successfully; cards always has 9 entries and may contain repeats

400.description: The user has fewer than 3 credits

401.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired token

500.description: Server error. Returns { error: "No characters available" } when the card collection is empty, otherwise { error: <underlying error message> }
